Square thumbs, names below, no permanent action rows or large teal buttons. One hover card has subtle + in lower right, tooltip "选择接缝后添加" and disabled plus because NOTHING selected on timeline. Resource catalog is sparse intentionally, don't invent unsupported transitions. Below card grid empty neutral area, discreet "3 个可用预设".
Center title "播放器 · 时间线01". A beautiful generic natural coast image WITHOUT logo or text, centered within a substantial dark letterbox/workspace, 16:9 frame about78% pane width.
